reviews.comment: Such a sweet and funny prof who actually cares about his students. He encourages discussions in class and is very passionate about what he teaches. Exams aren't too difficult if you prepare well. Make sure to look through his lecture slides since some questions are taken from minor details in them. Assigned groups for projects (not hard) in class.

Professor Marcantonio is easily one of the best professors I've had at TAMU. His lectures are so inspiring, and he is incredibly passionate about his work. There are three main exams and a final, all of which were generously curved. The content itself isn't inherently difficult, but there is a lot of memorization involved. Best science credit 100%

Franco's awesome. He's caring, he's funny, and willing to ask any questions you might have. Too many people in my class seemed to forget how exams work cause people panicked around the final. He also wears red shoes, so that's a plus as well.

i took this as an elective.....why did i get smacked in the face with a 80 question final. i took other hard classes that took up most of my time and effort, this was an unnecessary stressor in my life i hated it
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Such a great guy. Nicest professor I've had here and truly cares about his students. Tests can be difficult if you're not a science person, but a B is always obtainable. Go to class and take notes and you'll get an A in the class.

Amazing Professor, he is really passionate about his course. As long as you take notes during lectures and don't brush the class off, you can easily get an A. The exams are straight from the lectures, he's not going to give you trick questions. He curves the exams and is very understanding of any issues.

Professor Marcantonio was a good professor. He knows what he's talking about and tries to make the lectures easy to understand. Take notes, slides are most important for what's on the tests. Attendance is taken every class and is 10% of your grade so showing up matters. He curves tests by a good amount.
I really liked him! As long as you go to class and do the assignments you will be fine! He's super nice and cares about what he does. I did my HW in his class and still got a B so…

Such a caring and great professor. Brought us candy on Halloween, was super understanding, and a great guy. Tests are heavily curved and all of the content you need is on the slides he lectures over. Giving an ounce of effort outside of class means you should get an A in the class, would highly suggest taking if you need the Science credit.

Genuinely a good dude and teacher. Attendance is mandatory but lectures are interesting as long as you're engaged. Slightly test-heavy, but all test averages are curved up to an 85, so it's hard not to get an A as long as you do the bare minimum and study properly. The textbook is helpful, but all the questions are taken directly from the slides

Great person, I really enjoyed this class. A lot of ppl are taking it as an elective so were disrespectful during class... i felt bad because his lectures were amazing and he really cares about his students and is passionate about his work. Easy A if you pay attention and do all of your work. Would take again.

I loved this professor!! He is very passionate about the subject he teaches which makes learning exponentially easier. The exams have many questions but they're very easy with some review, and the curves are GENEROUS. Warning, the group projects in class can be tedious, but generally good grades there are doable. I enjoyed his lectures!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Marcantonio is a very nice person. Don't worry if something bad happens during the semester because he is very caring and understanding.

Passionate guy teaching a "boring" subject but you can tell he clearly cares about Geology. All tests were curved (final included) by like 10 points out of a 100. If you put in a little effort in studying an A is very manageable. Front and Back cheat sheet on final.

I had Franco for both GEOL 150 and 110. He was amazing in both and is easily the best professor I have had. His lectures are entertaining, and he is very passionate about what he teaches. The course work is not difficult, and he is incredibly nice if you talk to him. He tries to make connections with his students, and I cannot recommend him enough.

He was an amazing teacher! His attendance is only mandatory on days that have group assignments, but his slides and lectures are important for exams. He is also extremely sweet and very passionate about geology. He curved all exams by at least 7 points, and allowed a front and back cheat sheet on the final. He was my favorite prof this semester.

My favorite prof! Passionate about what he teaches & I found his lectures interesting. He just wants you to show up to class & participate, & you should! He makes class enjoyable. Final group project that was tricky because of my group. ~5 group activities too. Final was easy because I went to class, he also allowed a cheat sheet for the final!

Very easy science credit! He's such a passionate and sweet prof! Attendance mandatory occasionally w/group project, and quizzes are all online. Def read the textbook tho. I would read all the chapters the day before the exams and i'd pass easy. He gave us 10pt extra credit on every exam, and allowed us a whole cheat sheet front/back for final!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: Great professor! Very passionate and caring for his students success.

He was a wonderful teacher, would absolutely take him again. He was funny and very good at engaging students into the lecture. A very sweet older man. Attendance isn't mandatory but i always recommend going to his class, it never felt like a chore and the more engaged you are in his class the better that you perform on tests.

Franco is a super kind guy. Always curved tests and cared about students. He is very passionate about his work so if you respect him and show interest in his work you will get along great. There is a quiz every week but they truly help your grade, not hurt and he drops your lowest quiz grade at the end of the semester.

He's honestly a fantastic teacher. Here are some pros and cons that I experienced. Also, one major thing is if you're not going to attend every class, look on Canvas for activity days and attend those days.
Pros: Curves test, Not a hard grader, Class isn't mandatory
Cons: Reading textbooks is a must for tests, lectures are boring
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He's such an animated guy and is genuinely a good professor, and while I feel the subject itself is harder than it should be, he's very good about keeping it simple and explaining the why behind geology.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was one of my first professors here at TAMU as a freshman and I could not have had a better experience. As long as you read the textbook and pay attention in class, you will get a good grade.

He is a nice man but his exam are so difficult. I am a senior in this class & I genuinely have not taken a harder exam class. You HAVE to read the textbook. I am fighting tooth & nail for an A & it feels ridiculous as an introductory course. Would not take him again solely because of the exams that require background knowledge that he doesn't give
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Marcantonio is a very nice, knowledgeable professor. He made GEOL 101 far too hard for a basic level class though. He does not realize that everyone in his class does not enjoy Geology or plan to become a geologist. Exams were way harder than necessary, though attendance was not required at all outside of a few group projects.

He is very passionate about his job and cares A LOT about attendance. The actual class itself is pretty easy and not time consuming with only one final exam. The final exam was just free response questions with cheat sheets. Overall a good class to take!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
This class is absurdly easy. My one complaint is that every assignment pretty much is a group project, and all groups are randomly assigned.

All that being said though you could probably sleep through every lecture and still get an A. Don't do that though because the course is legitimately interesting.

Dr. Marcantonio is an amazing professor! His lectures are in depth and engaging. There are many group projects so be prepared to come to class and participate. The course is easy if you pay attention in lectures and do your work!

there were quizzes every 3 weeks that were open note, group projects, and a final that is only worth 10% if your grade but you get to have a cheat sheet. attendance is mandatory and part of your grade. overall, would highly recommend this class!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr Marcantonio is great and very knowledgeable. Lectures are very informative. Class is ez if you read the darn book. He curved our exams too. Outside of lecture, he is pure class. Top notch guy who very friendly and personable. He is the main reason I changed majors to geology in the spring.

He clearly is very passionate about what he teaches. Going to lectures and taking notes is the only factor that will determine your grade, in my opinion. The quizzes and readings are very straightforward, and the tests are no more complicated. I walked away with an A without feeling I had to break my back for it. Go to class, you will pass!

He is very clear about what he expects. Puts a lot of time and effort into his class. Answers questions very clearly. Cares about the class and their understanding. He builds up a lot of understanding over time, building the logic for why things happen,going slowly.I'd show up to lecture because it is the best explanation of the content you'll get!

Took this class for the science credit. Quizzes every week and group activities every other week. Dr. Marcantonio is pretty funny and cares about his students. His lectures are interesting but make sure to read the textbook. Definitely required more studying than I thought but as long as you put in an effort you can easily succeed in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the kindest, sweetest people on campus. Out of a class of 200 people, he knows at least half of our names. I'm truly going to miss him. You're graded on easy group assignments, open book quizzes you get 2 attempts on, and multiple choice tests. The material is very "know it or don't," so you'll have to do a bit of studying.

Oh my gosh Franco is the best. Super funny and kind outside of class in office hours and very helpful. Tests can be hard but use the book and his lectures to study to be prepared. Group activities every other week plus take home quizzes but otherwise very layed back and interesting class. Would definetely take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Weekly take home quizzes that you have 2 attempts to do. Exams are curved and the averages are about an 80. Some in class assignments that are easy. Lectures are very boring, but he posts the slides so you don't have to show up necessarily.

Marcantonio was an extremely memorable prof, he is very knowledgeable, and does a great job explaining concepts during lectures. On top of that, he is extremely accessible outside of class. Would 100% recommend if you have the opportunity to take him!!!

He is a nice guy. The lectures are very long and detail oriented. The tests were not too hard because he does curve based on overall class performance. You do not need to attend lectures..just be prepared to do a lot of your own reading. Its really up to you for the grade you want in this class.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Incredibly smart and super caring. He made me feel appreciated and respected every day in class. His tests weren't too bad, and he curved them. There are four in-class activities and weekly online quizzes which are both pretty easy. This class is an easy A if you put in the work and care even slightly.

The class itself was easy. I barely showed up to lectures, barely studied and ended with an A. The professor is a cool dude who is passionate about the subject. He curved all the tests pretty fairly so that definitely helped my grade out + his name is fun to say. 5/5

All information for tests is in the lectures. Reading the textbook also helps. He communicates his expectations for what you should know for quizzes and tests well. Lectures are super interesting; he was honestly my favorite prof this semester. Attendance is important, as there are quizzes and activities in class about once a week.

This class was very enjoyable! His lectures are good as long as you go to class because he adds a lot more detail and content that isn't on the slides. He always tells you exactly what he expects of you and you can tell he cares about his students. He's enthusiastic and you can tell he loves what he does. Just beware of the intense eye contact

This is my second time taking Dr. Marcantonio and he is truly such a delight. Super passionate and always willing to help. He doe go a little fast pretty often but there are PowerPoints to help with that. In-class group projects, a bunch of quizzes, and 3 total exams make up your grade so there's a lot of room to succeed, plus he curves!

Dr. Marcantonio is very passionate about this subject; however, his lectures were long and monotonous. The test questions do not reflect his lectures. There are weekly quizzes (open note) and 5 in class group projects. He curves exams by 5+ points. The class is not hard if you attend lectures and do the work, but it was difficult to stay interested
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Marcantonio is a very engaging lecturer, and one of the best professors I have had at A&M. Exams were open note and very reasonable. He is passionate about teaching and his students, as well as the research he does at A&M. I cannot recommend taking a class with Dr. Marcantonio enough.

Dr. Marcantonio is an amazing prof. He cares for his students so much and really wants you to learn. There are a lot of group assignments that are easy. All quizzes are open notes and he gives you plenty of time on them. The final was difficult but it is only worth about 10% of your grade. Just go to class and you will do good. He deserves a raise!

Professor Marcantonio cares a lot about his students and what he was teaching. When I took it, there were 5 open note quizzes; each an hour long even though they should take no more than 30 min to finish. Group activities are not hard either, and the final project isn't too bad if you pay attention in class. Overall great class, would take again.

(It should say GEOS110 but whatever) I really loved him because he was very passionate about the course material, and he genuinely wanted us to learn this stuff for the good of the planet. His lectures were sometimes boring, but he himself was very entertaining and active. Assigns a LOT of group work though and the final project is a group one.

Dr. Marcantonio is very enthusiastic about what he teaches.  I took this class because it was just a required course, but good professors make such classes very doable.  His lectures tended to get a little monotonous and he assigned us groups for our projects (which is never a fun thing), but if you need to take a geology class, this is a good one.

Straightforward grader, you NEED the textbook. Exam questions were directly out of textbook. As long as you did the easy and short weekly assignments and had decent notes for the (pretty easy) exams the class was easy to do well in. Exams were usually curved 5+ points. Not a blow off class but can do well with limited effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He was very passionate about teaching. Tests were open book. He lectures straight out of the book, so attendance really isn't necessary. I would take him again in a heart beat.

So frustrating. Almost everyone in the class failed all of his tests. The exams were open notes and that didn't help at all. No matter how many notes I had, I couldn't pass his exams. He calls out students in his lectures which is incredibly anxiety-inducing and he's rude in his emails. Please don't take him if you're looking to pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took online. Tests were super confusing. Allowed open notes but they didn't even help. Never passed any of the exams. Constantly calling on students for answers
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Weekly quizzes and reflections. The quizzes were normally more difficult than the actual tests. Lectures not really that helpful because he just goes over photos from the textbook. All of your learning material comes from taking extensive notes throughout every chapter of the textbook. Very interactive during class with cold calling on students.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Extremely monotone speaker so it's difficult to pay attention to him. We only talked about rocks for two or three weeks before we talked about things like the ocean and glaciers. He doesn't give extra credit and doesn't let you turn in let assignments, so he's very strict. Since everyone was failing his tests, he gave curves. Not the best.

Not sure why he has such a high rating. Even though the tests were open books, everyone in the class was still barely passing his exams. It's unclear what's going to be on the exam. I would recommend for sure taking the time to do the quizzes and the participation reflections because they could really make or break your grade.

Dr. Marcantonio was my favorite prof this semester. For a class about rocks, his lectures are so enjoyable and he is just an all around amazing guy. He provides great feedback and will answer any question you may have. He does like to call on people during lecture to see if you know the information so make sure to read the chapter before class!

I am a geophysics major and had Dr. Marcantonio as my intro to physical geology prof. The way he explains things makes it easy to understand. He uses good slides and gives great feedback. He also assigned very helpful lab work. His tests were very easy to pass if you studied for them. Overall he made geology so much fun and I hope I have him again.

Dr. Marcantonio is a pretty good professor and this course is somewhat easy. He creates great power points for his lectures and posts them all online. As long as you are paying attention to the lectures and studying the material, this class is easy to pass.

Great speaker. Was not excited to take this class at the beginning of the semester but Dr. Marcantonio made the class interesting and understandable. He is passionate about what he teaches and is a pretty funny guy. Attend class, do the mastering assignments, and study for the tests and you should be fine.
Amazing professor. I would recommend taking him even if you have no interest in geology. On of the best I have had at A&M
Professor Franco Marcoantonio is passionate over the subject. He is assecable out side of class and helpful with any questions you have over the subject.

Took this class mainly for a science credit. Not a class you will get an easy A in but if you work at it you'll be successful. He lectures every class which can seem a little boring. But he gives hints about things on the test that you won't hear if you don't go. Very passionate about Geology and good at presenting it. I liked him as a professor.

If you aren't interested in geology and just need the class for an easy science credit, I do not recommend this class. Dr. Marcantonio is very passionate about geology, very nice, and always willing to help. 4 tests total as well as homework assignments (which are easy and will help your grade if you do well).
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Dr. Marcantonio is super passionate about geology, which made the class more engaging. 4 tests total, with about 14 homework assignments (which are super easy and will help your grade if you do well on them)! Super funny, caring, and was available to answer any questions you had on previous tests or homework during office hours.
Just go to class try to stay awake and review the powerpoints.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He cares a lot about his students and brings energy to lecture but if you don't find Geology interesting and just want an A for a science credit I wouldn't recommend this class. To get an A on his test a lot of studying is needed because of how much material there is. I am taking 5 classes this semester and this one takes up the most of my time.

Marcantonio really cares about what he does and he is a good professor but tests can be kind of tough. I made as high as a 90 on a test and as low as a 66. Studying is a must and must go to lectures or you will be lost. He is a great guy though and his office hours really helped me.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Marcantonio is such a good guy. He gives easy tests, reads off the powerpoints (but cracks some jokes), and is so passionate about what he does. Textbook is recommended, but I didn't really use it. Study the powerpoints and you will do just fine.

Marcantonio is a great prof. He is kind of unorganized sometimes. He reads off of powerpoints and says to read the chapters. Reading the chapters makes the test easier but everything is pretty much on the powerpoints. He gives Mastering Geol online every week around 15 questions and it is pretty easy. He told us a 85 is an A.

He taught the honors 101 class, and it really was a blast.  His lectures are so helpful and he really takes interest in everybody.  By the end of the first week, he had all our names down and wants us to succeed.  I would highly recommend him to anybody that my need to take geology.
Very passionate about geology, he's a good professor. Most of what you need to know is in the powerpoints, but reading the book will definitely help your test grade.
